title: Unit indexing configuration
responsibility: Defines registry locations and default indexing rules and matches the supported path-pattern syntax.

inputs.name: pathMatches.path
inputs.description: Path string passed to the matcher; wildcard matching treats `/` as the segment boundary.

inputs.name: pathMatches.pattern
inputs.description: Pattern checked against the path; without `*` it matches exactly, a trailing `/` is a prefix, and wildcard `*` stays within one segment while `**/` can cross directories.

outputs.name: unitsConfigFile
outputs.description: Fixed filename constant for the units configuration; its value is `harness.units.json` and it is included in `defaultGlobalFiles`.

outputs.name: unitsDirectory
outputs.description: Fixed path constant for unit specifications; its value is `specification/units`.

outputs.name: scenariosDirectory
outputs.description: Fixed path constant for scenario specifications; its value is `specification/scenarios`.

outputs.name: budgetsLedger
outputs.description: Fixed path constant for the budget ledger; its value is `specification/budgets/ledger.ndjson`.

outputs.name: workloadsDirectory
outputs.description: Fixed path constant for benchmark workloads; changing a workload changes what every measurement of it means.

outputs.name: unitsConfigSchema
outputs.description: Strict Zod schema for objects with `schemaVersion: 1` and at least one workspace; unknown fields are rejected. Workspace roots, test/global/ignored entries, and reference from/specifier/reason fields must be nonempty strings, while reference to/external fields are optional strings.

outputs.name: defaultGlobalFiles
outputs.description: Fixed list of files whose changes can affect every unit and therefore every test.

outputs.name: defaultUnitsConfig
outputs.description: Default configuration has one workspace with an empty name and root `.`, tests `test/` and `tests/`, no global patterns or references, and ignores Markdown files, feature/loop specifications, and `.gitignore`.

outputs.name: pathMatches
outputs.description: Returns true for exact matches, trailing-slash prefix matches, and supported wildcard matches; `**/` can match zero or more directories and `*` cannot cross `/`.
